article.story: Loyola Chicago Ramblers (2-0) at Air Force Falcons (2-1) Colorado Springs, Colorado; Wednesday, 3 p.m. EST LINE: Ramblers -9.5; over/under is 161.5 BOTTOM LINE: Air Force faces Loyola Chicago after Grant Best scored 25 points in Air Force's 89-82 win against the Idaho State Bengals. Air Force finished 3-29 overall a season ago while going 3-15 at home. The Falcons averaged 61.5 points per game last season, 28.6 in the paint, 10.6 off of turnovers and 6.5 on fast breaks. Loyola Chicago finished 1-9 on the road and 9-24 overall last season. The Ramblers averaged 13.9 assists per game on 22.9 made field goals last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
